# Creative directions

Select by the intended feeling and its role in the brief, then read the linked guide. Examples indicate fit, not restrictions on subject or medium.

| Direction | Intended feeling | Useful when |
|---|---|---|
| [Cinematic](cinematic.md) | Awe and possibility | A memorable reveal makes an experience or capability desirable |
| [Demonstrative](demonstrative.md) | Understanding through seeing | Value becomes clear when a process produces a result |
| [Editorial](editorial.md) | Attention and considered judgment | Ideas, writing, or selected work reward exploration |
| [Human](human.md) | Recognition and trust | Personal situations, relationships, and reassurance shape the decision |
| [Sensory](sensory.md) | Tangible desire | Material qualities and the imagined experience matter |
| [Playful](playful.md) | Curiosity and participation | Discovery, experimentation, or progress can be enjoyable |
| [Precision](precision.md) | Clarity and control | People inspect information, compare choices, or operate tools |
| [Quiet luxury](quiet-luxury.md) | Confidence and discernment | Selectivity, craft, and restraint carry the value |
| [Campaign](campaign.md) | Conviction and momentum | One proposition needs to become memorable and actionable |
